stories.title: Helicóptero com Rick, da dupla com Renner, desaparece durante voo em SC

en.title: Helicopter with Rick, from the duo with Renner, goes missing during flight in SC
en.summary: The Brazilian Air Force is searching for a helicopter that disappeared after departing from Porto Belo, a coastal municipality in Santa Catarina state.

stories.title: Greve da Caixa continua após funcionários rejeitarem nova proposta do banco

en.title: Caixa strike continues after employees reject new bank proposal
en.summary: Workers at Caixa Econômica Federal voted against the bank's latest collective labor agreement proposal, with 59.3% opposing it in a virtual assembly. The strike is continuing.

stories.title: Quem é Rick, da dupla Rick & Renner, cantor que embarcou em helicóptero que desapareceu, segundo assessoria

en.title: Who is Rick, from the duo Rick & Renner, singer who boarded helicopter that went missing, according to his management
en.summary: Singer Rick from the musical duo Rick & Renner was on a helicopter that disappeared in Santa Catarina on Monday, according to his management. Businessman Bruno Avelar also appeared in a video Rick posted that day, though his presence on the aircraft was not confirmed.

stories.title: Bombeiros buscam helicóptero desaparecido em SC; cantor Rick, dupla com Renner, estava na aeronave

en.title: Firefighters search for missing helicopter in SC; singer Rick, duo partner with Renner, was aboard the aircraft
en.summary: Firefighters are searching for a missing helicopter in Santa Catarina that had singer Rick from the duo Rick & Renner aboard.

stories.title: Quaest: rejeição a Flávio Bolsonaro é de 56%; Lula tem 55%

en.title: Quaest: rejection of Flávio Bolsonaro is 56%; Lula has 55%
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows that 56% of voters reject Flávio Bolsonaro and would not vote for him, while 55% express the same rejection toward Lula. Other candidates surveyed include Romeu Zema with 43% rejection and Ronaldo Caiado with 40%.

stories.title: Bancários rejeitam nova proposta da Caixa, e greve nacional continua

en.title: Bank workers reject new proposal from Caixa, and national strike continues
en.summary: Employees of Caixa Econômica Federal voted to reject a new proposal from the bank, with 59.3% opposing it. The national strike by bank workers continues following the assembly decision.

stories.title: TSE forma maioria para manter suspensa campanha de Deltan Dallagnol ao Senado

en.title: TSE forms majority to keep Deltan Dallagnol's Senate campaign suspended
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court formed a majority to maintain the suspension of former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol's Senate campaign for Paraná.

stories.title: Quaest: Lula tem 37%, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 33% no 1º turno; candidatos empatam no 2º turno

en.title: Quaest: Lula has 37%, and Flávio Bolsonaro, 33% in first round; candidates tie in second round
en.summary: A Quaest poll indicates President Lula holds 37% of voting intentions in the first round compared to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's 33%. The survey suggests the candidates would tie in a potential second round.

stories.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 42% e Lula, 41%, em um eventual segundo turno

en.title: Quaest Survey: Flávio Bolsonaro has 42% and Lula, 41%, in a potential runoff
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula nearly tied at 42% and 41% respectively in a hypothetical second-round presidential matchup.

stories.title: TSE tem maioria para manter suspensão da campanha de Deltan Dallagnol ao Senado

en.title: TSE has majority to maintain suspension of Deltan Dallagnol's Senate campaign
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court formed a majority to uphold the suspension of former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol's Senate campaign in Paraná.

stories.title: Maioria do TSE mantém suspensão da campanha de Deltan ao Senado

en.title: TSE majority maintains suspension of Deltan's Senate campaign
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court voted to uphold the suspension of Deltan Dallagnol's Senate campaign for Paraná, confirming an earlier individual minister's decision.

stories.title: Quaest: Lula tem 56% entre beneficiários do Bolsa Família no 2º turno; Flávio vai de 27% a 30%

en.title: Quaest: Lula has 56% among Bolsa Família beneficiaries in runoff; Flávio goes from 27% to 30%
en.summary: Among Bolsa Família recipients, President Lula leads with 56% support while Flávio Bolsonaro's support increased from 27% to 30% in a Quaest poll.

stories.title: ‘Não podemos pensar na Bacia de Campos com cabeça de pré-sal’, diz Petrobras

en.title: 'We cannot think about Campos Basin with pre-sal mindset', says Petrobras
en.summary: Petrobras' exploration and production director stated that revitalizing the Campos Basin requires reducing costs and focusing on more economical wells rather than applying pre-sal approaches to the region.

stories.title: Conselho de minerais críticos deve ajudar na coordenação do setor, dizem empresas

en.title: Critical minerals council should help coordinate sector, companies say
en.summary: A newly created national council for critical and strategic minerals industrialization follows governance models from other countries and is expected to enhance coordination within a complex industrial supply chain, according to mining industry representatives.

stories.title: FT: Volkswagen é excluída de índice europeu de primeira linha em duro golpe para a montadora

en.title: FT: Volkswagen excluded from leading European index in major blow to automaker
en.summary: Volkswagen was removed from the eurozone's primary stock index for the first time in 15 years, a development that traders expect will further pressure the German carmaker's already declining share price.

stories.title: Quaest: 50% desaprovam e 44% aprovam governo Lula

en.title: Quaest: 50% disapprove and 44% approve of Lula government
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows President Lula's government maintains majority disapproval at 50%, while approval increased one percentage point to 44%, with negative evaluations rising to 42% from the previous week.

stories.title: Jorginho mantém a vantagem? Pesquisa Quaest em SC revela novo retrato da eleição

en.title: Does Jorginho maintain the advantage? Quaest survey in SC reveals new election picture
en.summary: A Quaest poll will measure voting intentions in Santa Catarina for the 2026 elections across state governor, Senate, and presidential races. The survey will be released on January 24 and includes interviews with 804 voters conducted between January 20 and 23.
